clinical_protocol_card.title: National Snakebite Envenomation Protocol (Polyvalent Anti-Snake Venom Serum IP)
clinical_protocol_card.test_procedure: Collect 2ml fresh venous blood in clean dry glass tube. Keep undisturbed for 20 mins. Invert tube: if blood liquid/unclotted, systemic envenomation confirmed.
clinical_protocol_card.recommended_dosage: 10 Vials Polyvalent Anti-Snake Venom Serum IP (Lyophilized)
clinical_protocol_card.reconstitution_instructions: Reconstitute each vial with 10ml sterile water. Dilute in 200ml 0.9% Normal Saline or 5% Dextrose.
clinical_protocol_card.infusion_rate: Infuse slowly over 60 minutes. Monitor vitals and observe for anaphylaxis every 5 minutes during initial 15 mins.
clinical_protocol_card.emergency_antidote_on_standby: Inj. Adrenaline (Epinephrine) 1:1000 (0.5ml IM) must be drawn and ready at bedside.
clinical_protocol_card.repeat_criteria: Repeat 20WBCT after 1 hour. If blood unclotted or neurotoxicity worsens, administer second dose of 10 vials.
clinical_protocol_card.cold_chain_warning: Store at 2°C to 8°C. Maintain in cold box until reconstitution. Do NOT freeze diluent.
clinical_protocol_card.authority_guideline: Standard Treatment Guidelines, MoHFW / WHO SEARO 2024

clinical_protocol_card.title: Snakebite Envenomation & Polyvalent ASV Protocol
clinical_protocol_card.test_procedure: Collect 2-3 mL of venous blood in a clean, dry, new, glass test tube. Leave undisturbed at ambient temperature for exactly 20 minutes. Tilt the tube gently; if the blood is still liquid and does not clot, the test is POSITIVE, indicating systemic envenomation (coagulopathy).
clinical_protocol_card.recommended_dosage: Initial dose of 10 vials (100 mL) of polyvalent Anti-Snake Venom (ASV) reconstituted in isotonic fluid.
clinical_protocol_card.reconstitution_instructions: Each vial of lyophilized ASV is dissolved in 10 mL of sterile water for injection provided with the kit. Gently swirl to dissolve completely; do not shake vigorously.
clinical_protocol_card.infusion_rate: Dilute the reconstituted ASV in 500 mL of Normal Saline (0.9% NaCl) or Ringer's Lactate. Administer the first 100 mL slowly over 15-30 minutes, closely monitoring for early signs of anaphylactoid reactions. If no reaction occurs, infuse the remainder over 1 to 2 hours.
clinical_protocol_card.emergency_antidote_on_standby: Adrenaline (Epinephrine) 1:1000 solution (Dose: 0.05 - 0.5 mL IM for adults, 0.01 mg/kg for children) and injectable antihistamines (Pheniramine maleate / Hydrocortisone) must be kept on immediate standby for anaphylaxis.
clinical_protocol_card.repeat_criteria: Repeat initial dose of 5 to 10 vials if blood clotting has not restored (20WBCT positive) after 6 hours, or if neurotoxic/hemorrhagic symptoms persist or worsen.
clinical_protocol_card.cold_chain_warning: Store liquid ASV at 2°C to 8°C in a cold chain refrigerator. Do not freeze. Lyophilized ASV must be stored below 25°C protected from direct sunlight.
clinical_protocol_card.authority_guideline: WHO Guidelines for the Management of Snakebites in South-East Asia (2024) & National Standard Treatment Guidelines, MoHFW, Government of India.

clinical_protocol_card.title: Snakebite Envenomation & Polyvalent ASV Protocol
clinical_protocol_card.test_procedure: Collect 2-3 mL of venous blood in a clean, dry, new, glass test tube. Leave it undisturbed at ambient temperature for 20 minutes. Tilt the tube once. If the blood is still liquid and does not clot (or flows freely), the test is POSITIVE, indicating systemic envenomation (coagulopathy).
clinical_protocol_card.recommended_dosage: Initial dose of 8 vials (100 mL) of liquid Polyvalent Anti-Snake Venom (ASV), diluted in 200-500 mL of isotonic saline (0.9% NaCl) or 5% Dextrose over 1 hour.
clinical_protocol_card.reconstitution_instructions: Lyophilized ASV (if used): Reconstitute each vial with 10 mL of sterile water for injection provided. Gently swirl to dissolve (do not shake vigorously). Once dissolved, combine all required vials and dilute in 200-500 mL of 0.9% Normal Saline for infusion.
clinical_protocol_card.infusion_rate: Start slow for the first 10-15 minutes (approx. 1-2 mL/min or 20-30 drops/min) to monitor for acute hypersensitivity reactions. If no adverse reaction occurs, increase the rate to complete the infusion within 1 hour.
clinical_protocol_card.emergency_antidote_on_standby: Adrenaline (Epinephrine) 1:1,000 solution (Dose: 0.5 mL IM for adults, 0.01 mL/kg for children) and IV antihistamines/hydrocortisone ready at bedside for immediate management of anaphylactoid reactions.
clinical_protocol_card.repeat_criteria: Repeat the 20WBCT after 6 hours. If blood still fails to clot, or if active bleeding continues, administer a repeat dose of 4 to 8 vials of ASV. Continue monitoring vital signs and clinical symptoms closely.
clinical_protocol_card.cold_chain_warning: Store liquid ASV between 2°C and 8°C in a refrigerator. Do NOT freeze. Protect from direct sunlight. Lyophilized ASV should be stored below 25°C in a cool, dry place away from moisture.
clinical_protocol_card.authority_guideline: WHO Guidelines for the Management of Snakebites (SEARO 2024) & National Standard Treatment Guidelines, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India.
